Koch Chemie Ceramic Body Cb0.01.summary: A chemically bonded ceramic sealant for painted surfaces, with resistance to acidic and alkaline cleaners, road salt and insect residue.

Koch Chemie Ceramic Neo C0.03.summary: A ceramic sealant that adds colour depth and a smooth surface, with protection against bird droppings and road salt.

Fireball Nano Coat V3.summary: A ceramic coating for painted surfaces, plastic, wheels, headlights and other exterior parts, with a smooth feel and deep gloss.

Fireball Devils Blood.summary: A ceramic coating that helps water bead and leaves paint with a glossy finish.

Fireball Butterfly.summary: A single-layer ceramic coating formulated for use in changing weather conditions.

Fireball DOK DO.summary: A two-layer ceramic coating with a hard base and a glossy top layer that resists chemicals.

Keramik PPC.summary: A two-part clear coating using Base A and Active B, with a wet-look finish and about 20 microns of coating thickness.
